proof.author: Rajesh Sawhney 🇮🇳
proof.text:
Third Wave Coffee 

Every time I visit HSR, my day begins with a shot of coffee at this Third Wave Coffee Outlet. 

It was about 5 years back that a friend invited me to this outlet for a meeting. I was amazed to see the level of energy and bustle at this cafe…it was full of startup founders and techies coding and sipping coffees, and I yes bumped into about 5 VCs there in a spate of 45 mins. I asked @etiwary why was this place so vibrant? She said they had designed cafe innovatively for tech workers and coffee was good and well priced. And she said they are raising some money to launch 10 more stores and would I be interested to invest?

I told her I wanted to invest and she introduced me to @sushant_goel founder of @thirdwaveindia who we met the same day and yes I bumped into him again yesterday at this same outlet. 

He informed me that Third Wave Coffee now has 125 outlets and over 40 in Bangalore alone. 

But they had their share of hiccups…post my investment, COVID struck and they had to shut down many of their outlets, 

Now they are expanding and how. They will be doubling the number of outlets in the next 12 months. 

Long live Third Wave Coffee

proof.author: LinkedIn
proof.text:
A few of us are getting together at Still Coffee in Indiranagar this Wednesday to talk about things we love to hypothesize about: building something meaningful, what actually constitutes a moat in an AI reality, and what most investors don't see clearly but should.

No pitch decks. No formal agenda. Just real conversations. Over coffee.
  
If you're a builder thinking through any of this, or just curious to chat with other people doing the same, come by. At Kriscore Capital, we back pre-seed and seed stage founders so we're always game to learn! 

Excited to hangout and jam with my friends from WaterBridge Ventures: Raj Nayan Datta & Sapna Goyal

Still Coffee, Indiranagar | Wednesday Sep 23 | 2PM onwards
